find: devCfgGeneration += 1; // a load still in flight now builds nothing into a closed pane
killedBy: the Configuration body loads when its pane first opens (issue #1015) a close during the load builds no body into the closed pane
the Configuration body loads when its pane first opens (issue #1015) a load that fails after the pane closed reports nothing into it
why: Issue #1015. The pane's close (every close is `back()`'s) stops spending the load's generation. `back()` goes on into `setState`, but by then the pane is leaving and the surface-change spend finds it closed, so nothing spends: a load still in flight builds the body into the closed pane, and a failed one writes its failure line there.
